### Install Packages
```{r}
install.packages(c("DBI", "RSQLite", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2"))
```

### Update Data
```{r}
system("git pull")
system("python migrate_to_sqlite.py")
```

### Loading Data
```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "weather.db")
forecasts <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM forecasts")
observations <- dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT * FROM observations")
dbDisconnect(con)

cat("Forecast rows:", nrow(forecasts), "\n")
cat("Observation rows:", nrow(observations), "\n") 
```
###

```{r}
forecasts <- forecasts %>%
  mutate(target_date = as.Date(target_date))

observations <- observations %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date))

forecasts %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(
    min_horizon = min(horizon, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_horizon = max(horizon, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n()
  )

```

###

```{r}
score_live <- function(obs_source_name) {
  obs_filtered <- observations %>%
    filter(source %in% c("open-meteo", "ec")) %>%
    filter(source == obs_source_name) %>%
    select(city, province, date, temp_max_actual, temp_min_actual)

  forecasts %>%
    filter(source %in% c("open-meteo", "ec")) %>%
    inner_join(obs_filtered, by = c("city", "province", "target_date" = "date")) %>%
    mutate(obs_source = obs_source_name)
}

temp_scored_live <- bind_rows(
  score_live("open-meteo"),
  score_live("ec")
)

temp_scored_backfill <- forecasts %>%
  filter(source == "open-meteo-backfill") %>%
  inner_join(
    observations %>% filter(source == "open-meteo-backfill") %>%
      select(city, province, date, temp_max_actual, temp_min_actual),
    by = c("city", "province", "target_date" = "date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(obs_source = "open-meteo-backfill")

cat("Live matched rows:", nrow(temp_scored_live), "\n")
cat("Backfill matched rows:", nrow(temp_scored_backfill), "\n")
```
